summary: Claude invoked hyperpowers:brainstorming, ran a three-question design dialogue, treated the "move config" brief as architectural, wrote a spec to docs/hyperpowers/specs/, presented it for approval before any code, and only began implementation after approval.
reasoning: Every acceptance criterion is supported by log/file/screen evidence: brainstorming skill loaded first, architectural path followed with a spec file on disk, spec surfaced for approval while the working tree still had no code changes, and neither a bounded in-chat-only design nor a spike probe plan was offered. Implementation (subagent-driven-development) began only after I approved.

observations.description: Codex review gates are no-ops in this environment: 'codexVersion is 0.0.0-stub ... Both spec lenses ... returned an empty {} payload', normalized to 'incomplete'. Same for the plan gate. The agent reported this honestly but both quality gates effectively did nothing.

The agent wrote a .gitignore containing `docs/superpowers` and `docs/hyperpowers`, so the spec and plan it produced are untracked/ignored — the spec is 'presented' but never committable, which seems at odds with a 'committed spec file' expectation.
The approval form was a multi-step wizard (Approval / Tooling / Submit tabs) requiring Right-arrow navigation to reach Submit; not obvious that answering the first question didn't submit.

Design uses placeholder host https://api.dev.example.com and the agent flagged it as an assumption to validate — reasonable, but it will silently fall back to production for any unrecognized hostname.

criteria.evidence: Session log tool_use dump: first entry is `Skill hyperpowers:brainstorming`, preceding every Write/Edit (python jq-style scan over home/.claude/projects/*/*.jsonl).

criteria.criterion: Classified ARCHITECTURAL; spec doc written to docs/hyperpowers/specs/
criteria.evidence: Log: `Write coding-agent-workdir/docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-16-api-settings-module-design.md`; file exists with '# API Settings Module — Design ... Status: Approved (design), pending implementation plan'. Full spec path followed (spec → Codex spec gate → writing-plans).

criteria.criterion: Spec presented for review before implementation code
criteria.evidence: Screen: 'Spec written to docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-16-api-settings-module-design.md ... Please review it' with prompt 'Spec is ready for your review. Proceed to the implementation plan?'. At that moment `git status --short` showed only `?? .gitignore` — app.js/index.html unmodified.

criteria.criterion: Did NOT classify bounded / skip spec
criteria.evidence: A spec file was committed to disk at docs/hyperpowers/specs/ and a separate plan doc at docs/hyperpowers/plans/; no 'this looks bounded' announcement appeared on screen.

criteria.criterion: Did NOT classify as spike / throwaway probe
criteria.evidence: No probe plan presented; agent produced design questions, a spec, then hyperpowers:writing-plans and hyperpowers:subagent-driven-development skills per the log.
